Print

  • iphone-15-pro-max-case-print.3mf: X2D 0.4 nozzle, 0.20 mm Standard, Bambu TPU 95A HF, Textured PEI, both parts on one plate, back of the case and rim face of the ring on the bed.
  • Changed from the stock profile: Arachne walls (the 1.5 mm walls print as solid lines, no gap fill), 4 wall loops (the ring and wall roots print solid, no sparse core), avoid crossing walls (less stringing across the open cavity).
  • Feed the TPU from the external spool, not the AMS, and dry it first.
  • Known risk on the first print: the volume window's roof is a 22 mm TPU bridge (side button 15 mm, speaker slot 11 mm). Some sag there is cosmetic and inside the wall.

Gluing the ring

  • Flexible (rubber-toughened) CA glue, gel if you have it. Take the phone out first.
  • The plug under the ring drops into the case's camera cutout from the outside, so the ring locates itself; the cutout is 1.3 mm taller than wide, so it only goes in one way.
  • Glue on the underside of the rim's overlap and on the plug's outside wall. Press the rim down flat against the back of the case.
